records.failureSummary: Implemented the zero-dependency HTTP skeleton with health endpoints and the data directory resolver. src/server.js now resolves PORT via src/lib/config.js (decimal digits 0-65535, default 3000 with a stdout warning on unusable values), binds 0.0.0.0, prepares DATA_DIR (src/lib/data-dir.js: resolveDataDir defaults to ./data, ensureDataDir does mkdirSync recursive plus directory/read-write verification) and exits 1 with a stderr report when preparation fails. src/app.js owns a (method, pathname) route table with GET /healthz, /health and /ready mapped to one shared handler (src/routes/health.js) returning 200 application/json {"status":"ok"}; every other method/path returns 404 with {"error":{"code":"NOT_FOUND","message":"..."}} through src/lib/responses.js. SIGTERM and SIGINT close the listener gracefully (idle connections closed, in-flight requests drained, forced exit after 10s, exit code 0); uncaughtException is logged to stderr and shut down, unhandledRejection is logged without killing the server. Logging stays on console.log/console.error: startup lines plus per-request method, query-free pathname, status and duration only, with control-character escaping and length limits; request bodies, headers (credentials included), passwords and secrets are never read into a log call. Verification: node src/scripts/lint.mjs exit 0, node src/scripts/typecheck.mjs exit 0 (13 modules), and a new stdlib-only developer smoke check node src/scripts/smoke.mjs exit 0 covering 200/{"status":"ok"} on all three health paths, the 404 envelope, recursive DATA_DIR creation, non-zero stderr exit for an unusable DATA_DIR, PORT default fallback and SIGTERM exit code 0. node --test currently fails only the pre-existing out-of-scope AC-21 home page test (GET / is not part of this task, so it returns 404); no existing test file was modified. Write policy rejected the test file I drafted at test/ac-01-health-endpoints.test.js, so AC-01 remains covered only by the smoke check for now, and the smoke helper was placed under src/scripts/smoke.mjs instead.
